fields.headline: Disturbance in Housing Unit 4 and medical emergency
fields.summary: An alarm in Housing Unit 4 at shift change brought a response from the incoming and outgoing shifts. One person needed medical care and was moved to Medical. The count is being reconciled.

actions.action: Control room reports an alarm in Housing Unit 4
Shift commander declares an incident and calls in off-duty staff
Health services moves one person to Medical
Sheriff’s patrol asked to stand by for transport support

fields.headline: Lockdown of Housing Unit 4
fields.summary: Housing Unit 4 is locked down while staff reconcile the count and a medical emergency is handled. All other areas continue normal operations.

affected: Visits to Housing Unit 4 are suspended
Court transport from Housing Unit 4 is delayed
Meals for Housing Unit 4 are served in the unit
lockdown.expected: Until the count is clear. Next update at 16:00.

fields.headline: External notification list
fields.summary: Notifications required or recommended after the incident, with status at 15:30.

notified.who: Families of those in the unit
